0.content:
Lisa calls Jean a gifted and dedicated leader whose hard work makes even Lisa want to help. Jean says that when Lisa is around, she always has peace of mind, and she looks to Lisa for potions to keep her awake. Lisa was at Jean's side when the Traveler first came to headquarters (1.0) and went to the Temple of the Lion because "Jean trusts me". She helped organise the Knights' party for Jean during her day off. She sometimes greets people sleepily with "Good morning, Jean" before realising who it is.

Lisa worries that Jean will burn out. During a limited-time 2.5 event she dragged Jean to Angel's Share, ordered a Love Poem ("medium, extra sweet") and told the Traveler that Jean is the only person she knows who needs to be taught how to relax. At the 1.4 Windblume Festival (limited event), Jean took Lisa on patrol and forbade electrocuting drunks; Lisa insisted the last one was practically begging for it. Jean gave her an extended paid vacation in 3.4.

In 6.2 Jean asked Lisa to tutor the newly arrived Durin. In 6.4 Lisa hoped Varka's return would finally let Jean relax. During the 6.4 homecoming (limited event), Jean sent Lisa to ask the expedition knights' families about their changing tastes.

1.content:
Razor was raised by wolves in Wolvendom and brought into contact with the Knights by Varka. Lisa taught him how to use his Electro elemental energy and never expected him to master it so fast. He calls her "Teacher" and sums her up as "Lisa lightning makes the sky black. She is strong. She is scary." Her voice-over has her coaxing him to combat practice ("good boy!") only for him to bolt.

During the 3.1 Weinlesefest (limited event), a letter from Varka, written in the far north and carried home by Mika, told Lisa that a box of Razor's parents' mementos sat in Jean's office and it was time he had it. Lisa worried he might shut himself off from his teacher if upset, and asked the Traveler and Paimon, whom he trusts as friends, to tell him. She explained the Thousand-Wind Wine they found and treated helping him as one more tutoring session.

2.content:
Lisa studied for two years in the Spantamad Darshan under the sage Cyrus, who calls her his best student in two hundred years. She graduated, then went straight home. Officially the reason was unknown. Privately: she saw raving-mad scholars in the forests and powerful sages wasting away on advisory councils, and asked how much one must sacrifice for the deepest knowledge. Unwilling to pay, she left and has stopped short of taking things too seriously ever since.

In a limited-time 3.4 event she returned to Sumeru on an extended paid vacation, in time for her Darshan's reunion. Her old classmate Gafoor, now a professor, tried to win her back: she could have been a Herbad by now. She refused. Cyrus knows exactly why she left and would never ask, she said, and "the price of seeking wisdom is no longer something I'm willing to pay." Looking after a library is important work too. She told the Traveler that Cyrus's big projects reached for wisdom beyond mortal understanding and mostly failed, and asked them to keep that between them. She prefers work that starts after 10:00 in the morning, with afternoon tea.

Her outfit description adds that she completed many unfinished projects, was allowed to study the hardest topics, and was tipped as a possible youngest-ever sage if she adjusted her field. Instead she withdrew from her main project and skipped the signing ceremony, likening her work to putting misplaced books back on the shelf. Gafoor wished her luck in Mondstadt as he left.

3.content:
Lisa took a liking to the Traveler at their first meeting and has called them "cutie" ever since. She offers to be their teacher, master or friend, and plays at making them her "star pupil" with a forehead kiss in one voice line. She is curious why the Traveler can use the elements without a Vision. In her Serenitea Pot dialogue she says they are special to her and that she does not count the effort when it is for them. This affectionate teasing is her character; canon gives them no romance.

In the Prologue the two cleared the Temple of the Lion together. In her Story Quest she took the Traveler along to collect overdue books, let them keep the recovered storybook as its "custodian", and gave them a Teyvat Travel Guide. In Sumeru (3.4) she was impressed that they had handled a crisis involving the God of Wisdom; Nahida's mind-reading showed her privately thinking how much the Traveler had grown.

4.comment: Lisa: The Library and Overdue Books
4.content:
The library at the Knights of Favonius Headquarters is, Lisa says, the largest in northern Teyvat, and she has read every book in it. She signs books in and out at the counter like a languid cat. Every library copy carries an elemental marker so it can be traced. In her Story Quest (Tempus Fugit Chapter, 1.0) the Traveler wanted a travel guide; finding it overdue, Lisa went door to door collecting books, and learned from Donna that one had been stolen. They followed its elemental trail to a ruin. There a Cryo Abyss Mage named Emery claimed the book held "the secret" and refused to give it back; Lisa electrocuted him on the spot. The book was an ordinary copy of The Pale Princess and the Six Pygmies.

Kaeya warns everyone that a late book once left his arm numb. Fischl returns books three days early. Lisa recommends the alchemy workshop upstairs to friends, but asks them to knock first. Hertha will not let her use the disused interrogation room as a private workshop. By the Serenitea Pot era she notes that more people return books on time.

The stolen storybook was written by "M", the Hexenzirkel witch Andersdotter. The travel guide Lisa gave the Traveler, by Alice, mentions "Miss Lisa" by name.

5.content:
Klee says Lisa is the best because she sneaks her treats at the workshop. Lisa once refused to let Klee use the workshop for experiments, and Klee sulked for a day before happily going off to play. During a limited-time 1.6 event, Lisa helped Klee and the Traveler read the Dodo-King's summons. She found hidden elemental script on the letter, had the Traveler copy it with Elemental Sight, and recognised the Golden Apple Archipelago from sailors' legends in her books.

In a limited-time 4.1 event, invasive Sumeru fish appeared in Cider Lake and Klee had spotted them. Lisa invented the game Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure, based on a student game called Shroomsplosion, and ordered grilled fish and desserts from Good Hunter. This kept Klee happily in the city while the Investigation Team dealt with the fish.

6.content: When Lisa joined the Knights, Grand Master Varka meant to make her Captain of the 8th Company. Its Field Officer, Nymph, resented an academic taking such a high post. Kaeya proposed a practice bout of magic. After two minutes Lisa graciously declined, saying Nymph "manifestly possesses the requisite ability". For a year Nymph sent Varka referral letters naming only Lisa Minci; Varka began handing them to her directly, and she always found an excuse. The company would surely have been stronger under her, but she judged that much power superfluous and risky for her in a way few could appreciate. Above all, extra danger meant extra work.

7.content:
Cyno studied under the same Spantamad sage as Lisa, and she calls him her junior. She has barely kept in touch with the Akademiya beyond courtesy letters to her teachers, but notes that Cyno leads an action-packed life. Cyno says that as General Mahamatra he has seen many tragedies among over-zealous scholars, so her decision makes sense to him. In the manga, her letter to their teacher brought Cyno to Mondstadt, where he sealed the power inside Collei. During the limited-time 3.5 Windblume Festival she greeted him in the library as "my underclassman". She teased that he took after Cyrus's wit and eccentricities while she took after his poetic phrasing. Cyno considers her as much part of Cyrus's family as he is.

In 5.6 she mentioned that her old professor had written to her, and that she reassured him she always "treats others with kindness", since a student inherits her teacher's ways and hers was "a gentle old man".

8.content: In the official manga, set before the Traveler arrived, the young Collei came to Mondstadt carrying a dangerous power. Lisa compiled the Knights' reports on the Black Fire Incident and sought her old teacher's help with an ancient script in a Fatui file, which brought Cyno. Before Collei left with him for Sumeru, Lisa helped her write a thank-you letter to Amber. They are still pen pals. Lisa notices Collei trying out new words in every letter and credits her "wonderful and warmhearted master". Collei laughs, relieved, on learning Lisa calls the Traveler "cutie" too. In 3.4 she regretted not yet having had time to visit Collei in Gandharva Ville, though she planned to leave Sumeru from there.

9.content:
When the reborn dragon Durin first came to live in Mondstadt, Jean was not sure what to do with him, so Lisa stepped in as his tutor. If she could handle a boy raised by wolves, she reasoned, one who is part dragon should be easy. She taught him to read and write and to keep quiet in the library. Seeing that he longed for friends but hesitated, she gave him an extracurricular assignment: go out and observe how Mondstadters interact. He failed to finish it. She did not blame him, because she could see he had already found his place among people.

Durin recalls trying to nap behind a propped-up book during homework and waking to find her smiling over him. She praised him for "learning the most valuable lesson", which he took to mean owning up to mistakes. In his 6.2 story quest she helped the Traveler track down three phantom books that appeared and vanished from the shelves. She showed them a book of forbidden alchemical formulas that Albedo had asked her to seal on the restricted list. Later, when people were losing their memories, she eased Durin's mind by calling it a plot twist waiting to be resolved.

10.comment: Lisa: Albedo, Sucrose and the Alchemy Workshop
10.content:
Lisa's other duty is keeping the Knights stocked with potions, done in the alchemy workspace above the library that she shares with Albedo. She praises Albedo as an alchemist who always has a solution, and adds that he is easy on the eyes. Albedo values her perspectives but wonders what hidden reason keeps someone so talented in a librarian's job. She warns people not to startle the shy Sucrose; Sucrose wonders how Lisa keeps advising her on the core of research she has never seen. Lisa spent two weeks and an enormous budget building the Special Heating Cauldron (time-delay heating, semi-automatic ingredient insertion, temperature control). It can do any precision heating job in two lever pulls, and mostly keeps her tea warm.

In a limited-time 4.5 event, Jean asked Lisa to improve the public image of alchemy. Lisa opened a potion shop, recruited the Traveler to run it, taught them the basics and herb cultivation, and sent them to Freda of the Logistics Company for supplies.

11.content:
When the Traveler first reached the Knights' headquarters, Jean introduced Lisa as the resident Librarian. Dvalin's rampage had left Mondstadt's Ley Lines "like a yarn ball in the paws of a kitten", and Lisa joked she was one elemental particle away from a full-blown breakout. Her detection magic showed that Stormterror was drawing power from the abandoned Four Winds' temples. She and the Traveler cleared the Temple of the Lion and destroyed the crystal there, with Lisa fighting alongside as a trial character. She was pleased when the crisis was resolved.

In the Natlan Archon Quest (5.0) the Traveler remembers her remark during the crisis that impurities and the elemental energy they embody repel each other. That memory helped them purify Abyssal corrosion again.

12.comment: Lisa: Varka and the Nod-Krai Letters
12.content: Varka offered Lisa her first captaincy and kept forwarding the letters that urged it. From the expedition he trusted her with Razor's family history (3.1, limited event). In 6.4 the vice-captain Lohen brought Varka's letters to the library. Lisa joined the friends and family who each wrote a letter to Varka, letters that helped draw him home, and she was among the knights gathered at Windrise when he woke. Back in the library she announced that the archives were full of documents awaiting his review and that she would not let him run off until every one was done.

13.comment: Lisa: Paralogism and the Windblume Assault
13.content: During the 5.6 Windblume Festival, monsters infused with the dead dragon Durin's energy attacked Mondstadt, and Lisa left the library to defend the city alongside Razor and Albedo. Afterwards at Angel's Share she admitted it had been a while since she "unleashed my lightning during Windblume". Not on people, she added: well, once in a while. She insisted she had used only "gentle methods of electrocution", so gentle even Jean would not intervene.

14.content: In 6.2 an anonymous benefactor donated a large number of books to the library. Every title was new to the collection, and quite a few were banned. Lisa did not trust the sorting to just anyone, and doing it herself would take ages, so she was relieved when the Traveler took the commission. When they pointed out the strange titles and contents, she said even she had never heard of any of them, sensed trouble, and decided to steer clear of whatever lay behind it. Still, if a book exists, there is a place for it in her library, and better there than in more suspect hands.

15.content: Lisa knows of the secret Hexenzirkel and that Mona is connected with it. She calls Mona an excellent mage but says she is not part of "their Hexenzirkel"; Irminsul exploration and formal tea parties leave her cold. Mona interprets Lisa's constellation, Tempus Fugit, as an hourglass symbolising the trade-off between knowledge and time. To stop the sand you lay the glass on its side, and then it rests forever: "maybe 'becomes lazy' is more accurate."

16.content: Canon but not universally known. Invitation of Windblume (1.4): patrol with Jean, policing drunks. Midsummer Island Adventure (1.6): decoding Klee's letter. Of Drink A-Dreaming (2.5): taking Jean drinking. Of Ballads and Brews (3.1): Varka's message about Razor; Lisa points out Mika, who carried the letter. Second Blooming (3.4): vacation in Sumeru, refusing Gafoor. Windblume's Breath (3.5): chatting with Cyno in the library (Collei is also visiting), and introducing Mika to Bennett and Razor. Dodoco's Bomb-Tastic Adventure (4.1). Alchemical Ascension (4.5): the potion shop. Soulblazers' Snowbound Journey (6.2): she checks out books for Xilonen's party, including a sleeping leopard's choice of pillow-book. Homeward, He Who Caught the Wind (6.4): see the drinks entry.

17.content: In the limited-time 6.4 homecoming event, Lisa took part in Nicole and Alice's memory bubble project, though she found it dull and missed comfortable chairs and good tea. Later she asked the Traveler, running a drinks stand, for something to lift her mood. The Snow-Kissed Dawn left her too energetic. After a chat (a Fontaine chef over-caramelising savoury dishes, expedition knights craving Natlanese cocoa, a detour to Wolvendom with the patrolling knight Ematol to deal with rifthound whelps), the Traveler mixed a gentler drink, named it "Slumbering Rose", and Lisa gave it full marks. She likes caramel in her tea and says her tastes have settled into comfort and routine.
